concerns.text: The verification clause for T014 ('executing the documented commands on a clean GitHub Actions runner reproduces all files listed in `results/` and `figures/` with identical SHA‑256 checksums') is practically untestable because many artifacts (e.g., PNG plots, model weight files) can contain nondeterministic metadata (timestamps, floating‑point rounding) that changes across runs, making exact checksum equality impossible without additional deterministic controls that are not specified.
